coastal_overlay.additional_limit: Lowest surface constraint of 10 feet and the applicable zoning maximum both remain operative.
coastal_overlay.base: Finished grade under the referenced 1970 Uniform Building Code method

overall.low_point: Lowest existing or proposed grade within 5 feet of the structure perimeter, or at the property line when closer than 5 feet.
overall.maximum: Base-zone maximum plus the lesser of the footprint grade differential or 10 feet; no top point may exceed the zone maximum by plumb-line measurement.

per_structure.separate_when: Structures are separated by 6 feet or more.

plumb_line.rule: Each point at the top is measured vertically to the lower of existing or proposed grade directly below.

roof_and_parapet.conditional_exclusion: §113.0270(a)(5) applies only when all stated development and roof-form predicates are proven; it is not a default RM-2-5 exclusion.
roof_and_parapet.default: Top points are measured unless an express Code exclusion applies.
